scope: current complete Tier-1 pool, two recruit turns and sampled combats, eight Patchwerk players
training_target: binary set of all maximal frozen heuristic values among candidates_for
training_interpretation: behavior cloning only; labels are not combat values

selection.evaluation: complete actor-controlled two-turn episodes against simultaneous frozen practical control
selection.failure_penalty: all samples must complete; otherwise episode score zero; every attempted seed in denominator
selection.experimental_eligibility: zero learner/control failures, paired lower95 bound >= -margin
selection.fallback: practical remains recommended; best learned candidate is evaluated as experimental even if all declined
selection.independent_test_promotion: single frozen learner only: paired lower95 > 0, zero learner/control failures and timing violations, live snapshot verified; fixture only

objective: mean score over the first two sampled combats: win1, tie0.5, loss0
shortlist: unchanged candidates_for max16, preserves practical at index0
unsupported: reject whole expert trajectory; retain all validation/test attempts with per-policy failures
